name: Resuming parked tasks: waiting, blocked, deferred (and canceled/rejected)
description:
Reported by heca-dev2 and the user 2026-10-20: a task in status `waiting` cannot be moved to in-progress by any agent tool, nor from the Web UI. Example: heca P104(F012)/T525, parked `planned -> waiting` on 2026-10-15 with a saved checkpoint, dependency done.

Current rules (read in the code):
- Start: checkExplicitTaskStart (packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts:216-245) accepts status `planned` only, or `waiting` when the task is the temporary task of an approved/active deviation (added in 7c4b04b "honor explicit ready task starts"). Every other status returns "Task is not startable from <status>.". Used by MCP planner-task-start/switch (plan-mcp/src/index.ts), Pi task_start/task_switch, and the server route POST /tasks/:id/start (plan-server/src/serve.ts ~1093).
- Update: planner-task-update, Pi task_update and server PUT /tasks/:id refuse `status=in-progress` ("Task start/resume transitions require planner-task-start", plan-mcp/src/index.ts ~1718; serve.ts ~1259).
- Reopen: PlanStore.reopenTask (plan-store.ts ~3683) only accepts `done`.
- Result: waiting, blocked, deferred, canceled and rejected tasks have no direct path to in-progress. The only way out is a two-step workaround: update to `planned` with a motivation (needsMotivation, plan-core/src/schema.ts:220), then start. That works but is undiscoverable: the start error does not say it.
- The planner already treats waiting/blocked/deferred as "on hold" work to re-check (on-hold.ts, accepted decision "Parked tasks are re-checked, never silently skipped"; recommendation flags them "may be ready"), but then refuses to start them.
- Web UI: the task detail page shows a Start button for planned AND waiting (packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx:66) but the server denies waiting, so the button always fails. The status dropdown (task-edit-modal.route.tsx, components/tasks/task-row.tsx) is disabled whenever the task has a checkpoint (pauseSnapshot) and never offers in-progress, so a checkpointed waiting/canceled task is stuck in the Web UI.

Goals: parked statuses (waiting, blocked, deferred) can be started directly through the normal start gates (reads, dependencies, hard blocks, active-task conflict, checkpoint resume notice). canceled and rejected stay a deliberate decision: not startable directly, but every refusal says the exact way out (set to planned with a motivation, then start; done -> planner-task-reopen). The Web UI Start button appears only for statuses that the server accepts, and a checkpointed canceled/rejected task can be moved back to planned from the UI.

Behaviours to preserve: one in-progress task per session and the switch/checkpoint rules; session ownership (taskOwnershipConflict); the temporary-override path; completion needs planner-task-complete; reopen needs confirmation; AGENTS.md rule 18 (web-ui-dist is tracked: rebuild and commit the bundle with the UI change).
